scope: publication candidate and aggregate result verification, not model promotion
checks: All 24 public Job ledger entries match local supervision, acceptance, input and worker receipt hashes; sanitized independent Job projection matches its source.
Public aggregate evidence matches local records, 24 games and 24 primary audits, 719 additional official transitions and 20 matched callbacks.
Opponent summaries and paired means -513.5, -950.5 and +437, bootstrap intervals and nine exploratory guardrail failures agree with the independently reviewed result.
No game Job recorded a confirmed empty exit; claims about artificial Job testing do not infer a naturally observed race.
Default Bot, frozen model byte hashes and prior failed panel evidence identities match; no automatic promotion or significance is claimed.
Candidate evidence includes no replay, trace, raw Job log, raw worker receipt or model artifact; common path/PID/private configuration patterns were checked.
limitations: No new game or replay was run, and no raw replay or trace was decompressed in this review.
Three seed clusters do not support a significance or generalization claim; repeated official replay uses the same engine and validators.
Memory and membership are sampled and not hard realtime limits; receipt checks are not independent process monitoring.
Public aggregates and hashes can be linkable; pattern-based privacy checks do not prove absolute anonymity.
Timing gaps and transient replacement followed by restoration remain possible.
